verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a self-serve 'Contract Generator' platform and D&O Questionnaire Portal, plus employment self-serve agreement generation, supporting interactive document assembly rather than static templates, but detail is thin and mostly marketing copy without a demo, screenshots, or independent corroboration. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the assembly tool's interactivity, detailed feature documentation, evidence of breadth of document types covered beyond employment/D&O forms.
